heroSlides.subtitle: Follow your inspiration. Pursue your interests. Study abroad. Join a team. Start something new. AU is the place where you can be yourself - whoever you may be.
Consistently recognized among the nation's premier institutions for top-tier ceramic art, engineering excellence, and business leadership.
Join a vibrant community of scholars, artists, engineers, and athletes united by curiosity, purpose, and creative fire.

visitCampus.title: VISIT THE CAMPUS
visitCampus.description: Experience life at Alfred University firsthand. Tour our beautiful valley campus, meet inspiring faculty, connect with current Saxons, and discover the creative, innovative spirit that makes AU extraordinary.

directions.driving: From I-86 (Southern Tier Expressway), take Exit 36 (Almond) and follow Route 21 South to Route 244 East into Alfred.

inTheNews.title: Master's in business programs among nation's best says 'The Princeton Review'
inTheNews.summary: Alfred University's College of Business has once again been recognized by The Princeton Review as one of the best on-campus MBA and business graduate programs in the United States.

inTheNews.title: Orchestra ready to 'scare up' musical sounds for Halloween-themed concert
inTheNews.summary: The Alfred University Symphony Orchestra and Chamber Players present their annual spine-tingling symphonic performance featuring classic cinematic horror scores and guest student soloists.

inTheNews.title: Allen Term 2024-15 classes available to all
inTheNews.summary: Registration is officially open for AU's accelerated Allen Term (Winter Session). Over 25 fully online accredited courses in business, humanities, mathematics, and science are open to all students.

spotlight.title: Take online courses during Winter Break
spotlight.description: Our Allen Term (Winter Term) offers more than 20 undergraduate and graduate courses to help you get ahead - all online! Courses are open to both current AU students and non-AU students.

spotlight.title: Homecoming
spotlight.description: Join us for Homecoming! All alumni, current students, faculty, staff & their families are welcome. Take a look at all the exciting activities taking place over the weekend. Go Saxons!

spotlight.title: New Art Galleries
spotlight.description: See our new online galleries of student and faculty work at Harder Hall, showcasing groundbreaking ceramic sculptures, glassworks, digital design, and multi-media installations.

didYouKnow.title: DID YOU KNOW?
didYouKnow.highlight: AU's School of Business is again rated one of the top in the nation by the Princeton Review.
facts: Founded in 1836, Alfred University was one of the earliest coeducational institutions in the United States.
Student-to-faculty ratio of 13:1 ensures deeply personalized mentorship and hands-on collaborative research.
Over 98% of Alfred University graduates are employed or enrolled in top graduate schools within six months.
Home to the world-renowned Inamori School of Engineering and NYS College of Ceramics.

stayConnected.title: STAY CONNECTED
stayConnected.description: Stay informed with the latest campus breakthroughs, Saxon athletic victories, alumni milestones, and regional cultural events.
stayConnected.newsletterNote: Subscribe to our weekly e-newsletter for faculty publications, lecture series, and scholarship alerts.

auStars.title: AU STARS
auStars.name: Dr. Peggy Wozniak
auStars.achievement: AU Alumna Dr. Peggy Wozniak entered the Commission on Independent Colleges and Universities' Hall of Fame for K-12 educators who have made a difference in New York.

departments.name: School of Art and Design
departments.description: Consistently ranked as one of the premier art schools in the world, renowned for ceramic art, glass sculpture, expanded media, and graphic design.

departments.name: College of Business
departments.description: AACSB-accredited business education fostering entrepreneurship, financial acumen, data analytics, and ethical global management.

departments.name: Inamori School of Engineering
departments.description: Global leaders in materials science, biomaterials, glass engineering, mechanical systems, and renewable energy technologies.

departments.name: College of Liberal Arts & Sciences
departments.description: Cultivating critical inquiry, creative expression, scientific discovery, and social justice across humanities and sciences.

departments.name: Performing Arts Division
departments.description: A dynamic home for vocal music, symphonic orchestra, theatrical production, choreography, and sound design.

courses.name: Foundations of Ceramic Sculpture
courses.description: Exploration of hand-building, wheel-throwing, glaze chemistry, and high-temperature kiln firing.

courses.name: Strategic Financial Analysis
courses.description: Corporate valuation, capital budgeting, risk management, and algorithmic financial modeling.

courses.name: Thermodynamics & Energy Transfer
courses.description: First and second laws of thermodynamics, closed and open control volumes, and thermal efficiency.

courses.name: Full-Stack Web Architectures & SPAs
courses.description: Modern client-side routing, single-page application lifecycle, asynchronous JSON APIs, and responsive design.

courses.name: Advanced Glass Casting & Annealing
courses.description: Studio mastery of hot glass blowing, casting molds, and optical clarity techniques at the AU Glass Center.

courses.name: Executive Leadership & Data Strategy
courses.description: Strategic planning, data-driven decision frameworks, organizational behavior, and corporate governance.

faculty.name: Dr. Sarah Miller
faculty.title: Professor of Ceramic Art & Design
faculty.bio: Internationally exhibited ceramic sculptor with works in the Smithsonian American Art Museum.

faculty.name: Dr. David Vance
faculty.title: Dean & Professor of Finance
faculty.bio: Former financial risk analyst and author of two leading textbooks on venture capital valuation.

faculty.name: Dr. Alan Huang
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Biomaterials
faculty.bio: Lead researcher on bioactive glass implants for regenerative medicine, backed by NSF grants.

faculty.name: Prof. Elena Rostova
faculty.title: Director of Symphonic Orchestra
faculty.bio: Conductor and chamber violinist acclaimed for bringing classical and contemporary symphonic works to life.
